spans.s:
m. (-कः)
A ram: see एडक.
E.
ड and ल being interchanged.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A sort of fish, (Cyprinus marginatus, BUC.) also एरङ्ग.

n. (-लु)
The name of a perfume: see the next word.

n. (-वं)
A granular substance apparently vegetable, of a reddish brown colour, and used as a drug and as a perfume.
E.
एला cardamoms, वल to breathe, उण् affix, and कन् added, or without कन्, एलवालु.

m. (-लः)
A name of KUVERA: see ऐलविल.

f. (-ला)
Cardamoms, the seed of the Eletteria cardamomum, or Alpinia Cardamomum: it applies to both the large and small cardamom, but most commonly to the former.
E.
इल to send, &c. अच् aff.

m. (-त्रः)
One of the chiefs of the Nāgas or serpent race.

f. (-र्णी)
A plant, (Mimosa octandra.)
E.
एल cardamoms, and पर्ण a leaf, ङीष् fem. aff.
